subject: Zoom meeting recap: Pioneer Coffee onboarding sync
transcript_text: Hey, good morning everyone. Can you hear me okay? Great, looks like we're all here. Hi Dani, thanks for joining. So let's get started. Dani Kim from Pioneer Coffee Roasters confirmed the menu list was sent over yesterday afternoon. She walked me through each of the eighteen items and the modifier groups. We agreed on a go-live target of 5/15. Dani mentioned that the hardware shipment is all on track and arrived at the roastery on Wednesday. She has the iPad and the receipt printer set up at the counter already. We did a quick run-through of the training session structure and she's comfortable with the two-week timeline. There was a brief discussion about whether to include the pour-over bar as a separate department or keep it under the espresso menu. We agreed to keep it under espresso for launch and revisit after thirty days. Dani also asked about the loyalty program integration. I told her we can enable that post-launch once we've validated the menu in production. She said that works for her. No outstanding blockers from her side. Action items: I need to send the training schedule by end of week, Dani will finalize the pricing on the seasonal drinks list by Monday, and we'll do a soft-launch dry run on 5/13. Sounds good, thanks everyone, talk soon.
